Boris
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Good — The north treeline by the fallen oak, at sunup. Pack and knife. We travel light."

wedgeSits.name: Boris
wedgeSits.actionLine: Boris falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."

wedgeSits.name: Boris

wedgeSits.name: Therese
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Good — The south slope below the meadow, morning, early. Pack light — we move fast."

wedgeSits.name: Therese
wedgeSits.actionLine: You unload both shares: 0 kcal from you, 0 kcal from Therese — 0 kcal into the pantry. The promise was missed; unloading does not earn kept-promise credit.

wedgeSits.name: Lucas
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Out on the road, away from Haven. A dawn meet's not something I can promise while I'm out — when I'm back, find me, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Lucas
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Then it’s set. The ridge above the creek, before the dew dries. Two packs between us."

wedgeSits.name: Lucas
wedgeSits.actionLine: Lucas falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."

wedgeSits.name: Lucas
wedgeSits.actionLine: Nothing came of that press. This patch has nothing left to give right now — walk to another green patch.

wedgeSits.name: Lucas

wedgeSits.name: Therese
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Good — The far treeline, past the rocks, dawn. Two packs between us."
